answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave measurement, such as SGX MRENCLAVE, plus a hardware-protected identity key, rather than to a software-generated key or VM image. Verifiers accept only approved code on genuine platforms with fresh, valid evidence, so cloning identities requires purchasing physical silicon and generating new attestations, not duplicating a virtual machine. Even a knoll at the nadir before dawn cannot defeat measurement, key-binding, and freshness checks.
